state:
You are the evidence adjudicator for the Bay Area Elections 2026 open dataset (schema 1.18), which tracks November 3, 2026 contests in nine Bay Area counties. For each scheduled local contest below that never appeared on any county candidate list, decide whether the assembled official county evidence is sufficient to mark it 'excluded - confirmed not on the ballot'.
Precedent for SUFFICIENT: (a) Alameda County 2026: the registrar's official Candidate List application printed an explicit per-race label 'Not On Ballot' -> accepted as an affirmative county determination; underlying cancellation resolutions were NOT required. (b) Contra Costa County 2026: omission from the county's exhaustive certified Contest/Candidate proof list -> accepted as confirmed not on ballot.
NOT sufficient by policy: absence from a single candidate list alone, or proposed-but-not-adopted agenda items.
CA Elections Code context: in nonpartisan local races, zero qualified candidates by the filing deadline (including any extension) means no contest exists; the election is cancelled and vacancies are filled by board appointment 'in lieu of ballot'.
All evidence was retrieved October 13-14, 2026 directly from county registrar documents and pages.

criteria.exclude_confirmed: The assembled official county evidence affirmatively establishes this contest will not appear on the November 3, 2026 ballot; sufficient to mark it excluded - confirmed not on ballot.
criteria.insufficient_hold: Evidence is suggestive but falls short of the precedent bar (no explicit county determination or exhaustive-certification omission); keep unresolved pending a cancellation/appointment record or direct registrar confirmation.

q1.instructions:
Santa Clara County, FOUR contests judged together: Lion's Gate CSD Director full-term (contest 6042, 1 seat), Lion's Gate CSD Director short-term (6043, 2 seats), San Martin County Water District Director (6080, 2 seats), Silver Creek Valley Country Club GHAD Director (6103, 3 seats).
1. ROV Contest/Candidate Proof List CFMR001 printed 8/7/2026 (exhaustive over all contests; totals verified: 133 contests / 283 candidates) shows each of the four with Num Cands 0 / Num Qualified 0 as of close of initial filing period; 6043 carries the '*' extension mark.
2. Extended filing closed 8/12/2026. The ROV's 'Final Qualified List of Local Eligible Candidates' posted 9/28/2026 - titled FINAL, linked from the ROV Nov-3 resources page as THE final qualified list for this election - contains ZERO rows for all four districts (extraction verified complete: contests 3120-6099, Grand Total 287). The same list DOES print 'On Ballot: No' rows for contests whose qualified candidates were later removed; these four are absent entirely because zero candidates ever filed.
3. CFMR028 Unofficial Write-In Candidate List printed 9/24/2026 (range covers contests 1030-6103) contains no write-in filings for any of the four codes.
4. Ballot/CVIG final printing deadline was 8/28/2026; with zero qualified candidates and zero write-ins these contests cannot appear in printed ballots or the County Voter Information Guide.
5. The ROV's own district pages now show the seats as 'holdover'/'appointed' incumbents up in 2026 (Lion's Gate: Sattler/Pashby/Stuart; San Martin Water: Norgard short-term + one Vacant seat; GHAD: Katwan/Hansen/Roberts holdovers).
6. Same-district precedent from prior cycles: zero filings produced cancelled elections, winners 'without appearing on the ballot', and 'Appointed in Lieu' notations in the registrar's own incumbent columns.

criteria.exclude_confirmed: The assembled official county evidence affirmatively establishes this contest will not appear on the November 3, 2026 ballot; sufficient to mark it excluded - confirmed not on ballot.
criteria.insufficient_hold: Evidence is suggestive but falls short of the precedent bar (no explicit county determination or exhaustive-certification omission); keep unresolved pending a cancellation/appointment record or direct registrar confirmation.

q2.instructions:
San Mateo County, CA2026-302 Bayshore Elementary School District Governing Board member at-large SHORT term (2-year unexpired).
1. Scheduled for Nov 3, 2026 per the county Candidate Guide and the July filing-open news release by Chief Elections Officer Mark Church.
2. Completely ABSENT from every print of the county's Roster of Candidates - the CFMR009 report header reads 'All Contests / Qualified Candidates Only', prints dated 7/31, 8/4 and 9/3/2026 (all three PDFs downloaded and text-searched; 'Bayshore Elementary' appears only as contest 3400 Full Term with 3 qualified candidates). The roster is the county's ONLY candidate list for this election; no later or final candidate list has been published (election page re-checked Oct 14, 2026 still links the 9/3 file). Every other office scheduled in the Candidate Guide appears in the 9/3 roster EXCEPT Bayshore Short Term and Colma Fire.
3. The county's extended-filing list (updated 8/12/26) included Bayshore Full Term but NOT Short Term - extensions occur only when an eligible incumbent does not file; a vacant seat triggers no extension, consistent with zero filings on the short-term seats.
4. Sample Ballot & Voter Information Pamphlet mailing began 9/25/2026 (county news release); a contest with no qualified candidates cannot appear on printed ballots already in voters' hands.
5. The district's own website lists its current board: Rudolph, Camarco and Marion Brown each 'Term: 2026' - consistent with incumbents holding over after cancellation.

criteria.exclude_confirmed: The assembled official county evidence affirmatively establishes this contest will not appear on the November 3, 2026 ballot; sufficient to mark it excluded - confirmed not on ballot.
criteria.insufficient_hold: Evidence is suggestive but falls short of the precedent bar (no explicit county determination or exhaustive-certification omission); keep unresolved pending a cancellation/appointment record or direct registrar confirmation.

q3.instructions:
San Mateo County, CA2026-308 Colma Fire Protection District Director at-large (1 seat, 4-year term).
1. Scheduled for Nov 3, 2026 per the county Candidate Guide and the July filing-open news release ('Colma Fire Protection District, Board of Directors').
2. Appeared on the county's extended-filing list updated 8/12/2026 (extension implies an incumbent did not file for re-election).
3. Completely ABSENT from all three 'All Contests / Qualified Candidates Only' roster prints (7/31, 8/4, 9/3/2026) - zero candidates ever; the only 'Colma' contest in any roster is Town of Colma City Council (5081), a different jurisdiction with four qualified candidates. Every other office scheduled in the Candidate Guide appears in the 9/3 roster EXCEPT Bayshore Short Term and Colma Fire.
4. No later candidate list published by the county as of Oct 14, 2026; Sample Ballot & Voter Information Pamphlet mailing began 9/25/2026.
5. LAFCO's district profile shows director Maryanny Hazard with term ending 11/2026; she appears in NO county candidate document for any contest.
6. The Town of Colma's own Nov-3 election page covers only City Council seats and never mentions a fire district race.

criteria.seats_2: The county Candidate Guide scheduled-offices table ('Bayshore Elementary School District, Governing Board (Short Term) - 2') is the authoritative count of seats up; the dataset should record 2.
criteria.seats_1: One seat is correct: some other reading controls.
criteria.unclear: Cannot determine from this evidence which count is right.
